mechanical.notes: Attempt-1 FAIL (page did not boot) fixed: solveCamera() is now called at boot (replacing the bare applyView()), so `solved` is populated before applyCameraPose reads it. Re-captured --page default + rear: console_clean:true / issues:[] on both (read from the correct sidecar keys this time), subject renders, and the 'ZONAS INTERACTIVAS' legend POPULATES with occlusion-aware reachability that flips correctly between views — FRONT: Botón + Pantalla + Chasis reachable (blue), Panel de servicio dimmed; REAR: Panel de servicio + Chasis reachable, Botón + Pantalla dimmed. The corrected pick() (stop at first visible surface, blockedBy names the occluder) is thus verified bidirectionally in the deliverable itself. THE BOOT CHECK EARNED ITS KEEP IMMEDIATELY: it caught a SECOND latent defect — __qaState() threw because the refactor turned `solved` from a single object into a per-view map while the solvedRadius line still read `solved.radius`; any probe calling __qaState would have crashed, and no module suite could see it because none calls the page's own API. It boots the REAL entry point with only createRuntime (the one GPU-needing function) stubbed, asserting: no exception, data-app-ready true, requestAnimationFrame called (render loop started -> not black), HUD label written, legend has rows, __qaHotspots/__qaState exist AND are callable, >=1 hotspot reachable. Builder also fixed a HARNESS fault (getElementById('canvas') returning a generic 200x60 element skewed the raycast) in the harness, not the product. And verified the Stratix with the same check (boots clean) without touching it.

notes: Inline orchestrator judgment. Strong recovery from the attempt-1 boot failure. The one-line fix (solveCamera at boot) restores rendering, and the deeper deliverable — the page-boot check I asked for — landed AND immediately caught a second page-only defect (__qaState crash) that seven module suites could not. The interaction UI is now fully judgeable and correct: literal hotspots, occlusion-aware reachability verified bidirectionally in the legend, a rear view that exposes previously-unjudgeable geometry and makes the honest receptacle absence visible.
